questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the create endpoint reports the newly created resource? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client retries POST /v1/transfers with the same Idempotency-Key and an identical body after a timeout. The first attempt had succeeded. What does the retry produce?
choices: A second transfer and a second debit, since each POST creates a resource
409 Conflict, because the key has already been used
200 with the original transfer, and balances do not change again
201 with a new transfer id but the balances only change once

questions.prompt: A client sends {"source_id": "acc_100", "destination_id": "acc_200", "amount_cents": true} with a valid Idempotency-Key. What is the response?
choices: 201; True is an int in Python, so it is treated as 1 cent

questions.prompt: acc_200 has 1000 cents. A client sends a transfer of 5000 cents from acc_200 to acc_100. What is the outcome?
choices: 201; the balance goes negative and is reconciled later
422 insufficient_funds; no transfer is recorded and balances are unchanged
400 invalid_request, because the amount exceeds the available balance
422, but the Idempotency-Key is now consumed and later retries replay the failure
